ideas.pitch: An automated e-waste or organic scrap composting bin powered by low-cost microcontrollers that monitors temperature, humidity, and decomposition rates, optimized specifically for campus hostel waste.
ideas.title: EcoJugaad IoT Composter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the hackathon's core theme of 'Scrap to Solution' by utilizing discarded electronic parts and local waste materials to create a functional, high-utility IoT device.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision mobile application running lightweight object detection models on edge devices to instantly classify household and industrial scrap items for upcycling and recycling potential.
ideas.title: ScrapSort AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines sustainability with practical software utility, giving judges a tangible way to see waste turned into sorted resources.

ideas.pitch: An automated irrigation valve controller built entirely from discarded plastic bottles, old PVC pipes, and surplus solenoid valves salvaged from discarded appliances, controlled via local Bluetooth.
ideas.title: AgriJugaad Drip Controller
ideas.why_it_could_win: Emphasizes the literal 'scrap to solution' mantra by repurposing everyday trash into heavy-duty agricultural hardware suited for rural Punjab.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local web platform connecting local artisans and students who create functional furniture and decor items out of industrial scrap and discarded materials with buyers in the region.
ideas.title: UpcycleMarketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides a commercial and social ecosystem that validates the real-world economic viability of upcycled scrap products.

ideas.pitch: A web calculator and testing simulator for agricultural stubble and plastic waste mixture ratios used to compress durable, low-cost building bricks.
ideas.title: BioBrick Calculator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Tackles the massive local problem of agricultural stubble burning in Punjab by turning it into a structured, engineer-friendly construction metric tool.
